purpose: Enrolled user opens course workspace and views course home details
preconditions: CourseWorkspace exists; User enrolled as Student

purpose: Unenrolled user attempts to access course workspace
preconditions: Course exists; User is not enrolled

purpose: Assigned Faculty updates syllabus and schedule
preconditions: Course exists; User is assigned Faculty instructor
action_or_input: Faculty edits syllabus and schedule text
expected_result: Updated syllabus and schedule persisted in database

purpose: Unauthorized role attempts to edit course workspace details
preconditions: Course exists; User is Student

purpose: Faculty uploads course material with immediate publication
preconditions: Course exists; User is Faculty
expected_result: CourseMaterial created with status=published and published_at set

purpose: Faculty schedules course material with future release date
preconditions: Course exists; User is Faculty
action_or_input: Faculty uploads material with is_scheduled=True and future release date

purpose: TA attempts to upload course material
preconditions: Course exists; User is TA

purpose: Student views published course materials
preconditions: Published course material exists; User is Student

purpose: Observer views published course materials in read-only mode
preconditions: Published material exists; User is Observer
expected_result: Published materials returned; no write permissions

purpose: Student attempts to view scheduled material before release date
preconditions: Material status is scheduled in future; User is Student
expected_result: Scheduled material is excluded from student response

purpose: Faculty posts course announcement
preconditions: Course exists; User is Faculty
action_or_input: Faculty posts announcement with title and content

purpose: TA with announcement permission posts announcement
preconditions: Course exists; User is TA with can_post_announcements=True

purpose: TA without announcement permission attempts to post announcement
preconditions: Course exists; User is TA with can_post_announcements=False

purpose: Enrolled user views course announcements
preconditions: Course announcements exist; User is Student

purpose: Faculty creates draft assignment with valid configuration
preconditions: Course exists; User is Faculty
action_or_input: create_assignment with title, points, instructions, due_date

purpose: Faculty edits existing draft assignment
preconditions: Assignment exists in draft state; User is Faculty
action_or_input: Faculty modifies assignment title or points
expected_result: Updated fields persisted while maintaining draft status

purpose: Faculty creates assignment with invalid points (points <= 0)
preconditions: Course exists; User is Faculty

purpose: TA attempts to create assignment
preconditions: Course exists; User is TA

purpose: Faculty publishes draft assignment immediately
preconditions: Assignment status is draft; User is Faculty

purpose: Faculty schedules assignment for future release
preconditions: Assignment status is draft; User is Faculty
action_or_input: publish_assignment with is_scheduled=True and release_date in future

purpose: Unenrolled or non-faculty user attempts to publish assignment via API
preconditions: Assignment is draft; User is unenrolled or non-faculty
expected_result: HTTP 403 Forbidden or rejection due to lack of faculty role

purpose: Student views published assignment details
preconditions: Assignment status is available; User is Student
expected_result: Assignment returned with instructions and due date

purpose: Student attempts to access draft assignment before publication
preconditions: Assignment status is draft; User is Student
expected_result: Draft assignment is withheld from student view

purpose: Student submits valid work before deadline
preconditions: Assignment is available; User is enrolled Student; before due_date

purpose: Student submits work after deadline
preconditions: Assignment is available; current time > due_date; User is Student

purpose: Unenrolled student attempts to submit assignment via API
preconditions: Assignment is available; User has no enrollment in course
expected_result: HTTP 403 Forbidden or rejection due to lack of membership

purpose: Student submits work with mismatched submission type
preconditions: Assignment configured for file; Student submits text

purpose: Student views own submission history and status
preconditions: Submission exists for Student 1; User is Student 1
expected_result: Own submission returned with content and status

purpose: Student attempts to view another student submission detail
preconditions: Submission belongs to Student 1; Requesting user is Student 2

purpose: Faculty evaluates submission and saves draft grade
preconditions: Submission exists; User is Faculty
action_or_input: Faculty grades submission with score and feedback
expected_result: Grade created with status=draft and graded_by_user_id=Faculty

purpose: TA evaluates submission and saves draft grade with attribution
preconditions: Submission exists; User is TA
action_or_input: TA grades submission with valid points
expected_result: Grade created with status=draft and graded_by_user_id=TA

purpose: Grade submission with score exceeding points_possible
preconditions: Assignment points_possible=100; Grader enters 105

purpose: Faculty releases all draft grades for assignment
preconditions: Draft grades exist for assignment; User is Faculty
expected_result: All draft grades transition to status=released with released_at timestamp

purpose: TA attempts to release assignment grades
preconditions: Draft grades exist; User is TA

purpose: Student views own released grade and feedback
preconditions: Grade is released; User is evaluated Student
expected_result: Released grade points and feedback returned

purpose: Student attempts to view unreleased / draft grade
preconditions: Grade status is draft; User is Student
expected_result: Draft grade withheld from student response

purpose: System scheduled content release when release date <= now
preconditions: Material status=scheduled with release date <= now

purpose: Scheduled content remains hidden when release date > now
preconditions: Material status=scheduled with release date in future
